caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with turned legs and armrests, featuring a slightly arched crest rail at the top and a horizontal backrest below it. The chair is colored in shades of brown to represent the wood grain, with some shadowing to indicate depth and light direction. The seat of the chair is covered with a reddish cushion. Resting against the backrest of the chair is a round pillow decorated with a floral pattern that includes shades of blue, green, red, and beige, and is bordered with a textured, fringed trim in pink or red. The background is plain, and the entire composition is framed within a light rectangle, suggesting the edge of the drawing or a mat around the image. Shadows of the chair and pillow are visible on the surface beneath the chair, rendered in grayish and purplish tones.
title: Slat-back Armchair
